real_errors.title: ORDERING 8.3 misstates how much of U9's lands lies outside the body: pads 5 / 6 expose 0.15-0.25 mm (not 0.10 mm) at each end, and pad 9 is not wholly under the body
real_errors.evidence: Board a0ec075e (pcbnew, .supervisor/r33_triage/u9.py): U9 B(18.5,81.6) rot 0; pad 5 BAT_IN x 18.10-18.40, y 80.40-82.80; pad 6 RAW_PROTECTED x 18.60-18.90, y 80.40-82.80; pad 9 BAT_ILIM x 19.10-19.70, y 81.70-81.95. B.Fab rect bounding box 17.40-19.60 / 80.50-82.70 with 0.10 mm line width, so its centreline (the body) is 17.45-19.55 / 80.55-82.65 = 2.10 mm. TI SLVSFC9C RPW0010A outline (drawing 4225183/A, cached .supervisor/r14_parts_pdf/tps25947.pdf): body 1.9-2.1 mm both axes. Body half 0.95-1.05 mm against land half-length 1.20 mm: pads 5 / 6 expose 0.15-0.25 mm (0.20 nominal) x 0.30 mm at each end; pad 9's outer edge 19.70 lies 0.15-0.25 mm beyond the body edge 19.45-19.55. Round 23's 0.10 mm took the Fab line's outer edge as the body. The probe points B(18.25,80.45) / B(18.75,80.45) and the R84.1 instruction remain correct.
